description: This file defines the AnonymousSignature class within the AWS SDK for PHP, implementing request signing behavior that does not perform any signing (anonymous access).

classes.name: AnonymousSignature
classes.description: Provides anonymous client access by implementing the SignatureInterface, returning requests unmodified.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Returns the request unmodified, representing a no-op signing operation.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Returns the request unmodified, used to generate pre-signed URLs with no signing.
